4(a) This is in response to your reapplest for our opinion relative to the applicability of Section 4(f) to the Roosevelt School property, F.A. Route 23 (U.S. 30) Lincoln Highway, Cook . County, Illinois. We regret the delay in our response.
4(a) Concur - It is to be noted that our request not only concerned the Roosevelt School property but also an involvement with the Cook County Forest Preserve District by way of a temporary construction easement. Our letter concerning coordination follows the response from U.S. Department of Interior in Appendix -"A".
In telephone conversation with Mr. Bob Frantz of the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation on November 14, 1974, Mr. Frantz said no additional response would be forthcoming concerning the Cook County Forest Preserve Property since the material submitted for early coordination and our cooperative efforts with the Forest Preserve District were well documented.
